Package com.csse3200.game.components.shop

Class ShopCatalog

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.shop.ShopCatalog
public final class ShopCatalog extends Object
Items offered by the shop and their placeholder prices.

Starting player gold is 50. These prices are easy to retune in one place.
